purpose.en: Femininity as personal expression, through moments and details chosen for yourself.
purpose.es: La feminidad como expresión propia, a través de momentos y detalles que eliges para ti.

signature.es: Tu propia forma de ser femenina.

initialAudienceHypothesis.en: Adult women in the United States who enjoy feminine details on their own terms. Validate through conversations; this is not a fixed definition of who belongs.
initialAudienceHypothesis.es: Mujeres adultas en Estados Unidos que disfrutan los detalles femeninos a su manera. Validar mediante conversaciones; no es una definición cerrada de quién pertenece.

positioningHypothesis.en: A considered, premium feel at an accessible price. Validate with real samples, costs and customer feedback.
positioningHypothesis.es: Una experiencia cuidada y premium a un precio accesible. Validar con muestras reales, costos y opiniones de las clientas.

logoWorkingRules.colors: Use one color, cherry on ivory or ivory on cherry; preserve asset proportions.
logoWorkingRules.clearSpace: At least one quarter of the symbol height around the symbol or full signature; keep type, trim and other artwork outside.
logoWorkingRules.validation: These are working guides. Test actual screen sizes. Print and embroidery require physical proofs; fine strokes may need a dedicated production version.

colorRoles.#BC1534: Cherry: signature, key actions, occasional statement panels

typography.Manrope: Body copy, product information, navigation and controls
typography.hierarchy: One expressive headline, then clear information. Spaced capitals only for short labels; keep essential details outside images.

examples.en: A first look at Rose. Materials and fit are still in development.
examples.es: Un primer vistazo a Rose. Los materiales y el ajuste siguen en desarrollo.

voice.avoid: Body-correction language, pressure to be desirable, and untested comfort or performance promises.

photography.direction: Warm daylight, generous ivory space, a cherry accent. Show the whole item clearly before texture details. Unhurried, personal editorial imagery.
photography.currentImages: AI-generated concepts, not proof of physical products or materials.
photography.beforeSales: Photograph actual samples, construction and colors. On-person photography should represent adult women across body types without reshaping bodies.

applications.label: Ivory ground, cherry signature. Separate readable care and size information.
applications.box: Cherry outside, ivory signature with clear space. Sample materials and finish.
applications.bottle: Uncluttered front with ALR symbol. Formula and container are not confirmed.
applications.status: Concept illustrations; not production files or photographs of manufactured goods.

futureApp: Visual concept only; implementation follows the web and commercial operation.
